rules.targetSize: no interactive element pins a height below 44px; the 44px floor itself is the global @media (max-width: 767px) rule in index.css, and the rendered box is measured in Playwright at 320/480
rules.textSize: no text below 12px (text-[9px] / text-[10px] / text-[11px] are refused)
rules.focus: no element removes the focus ring without a replacement; the ring itself is the global :focus-visible rule in index.css
rules.width: no fixed pixel width above 320px inside the admin/console/auth plane
